thread.title: Amazon Has This One Big Edge Over Facebook or Apple, 'Wolf of Wall Street' Says

author: thestreet.com
title: Amazon Has This One Big Edge Over Facebook or Apple, 'Wolf of Wall Street' Says
text:
If you put your money alongside that of the smartest institutional investors, "you'll probably do pretty well," says Jordan Belfort.
Belfort, aka the 'Wolf of Wall Street' , said the smartest individual investors follow institutional investors and look for firms with strong management. The leadership of Jeff Bezos at Amazon.com Inc. ( AMZN ) is part of why Belfort "would never bet against Amazon on anything."
Belfort said Amazon is a smoothly run operation that allows customers to talk to real people when they come across issues. The same can't be said for other high-flying tech companies including Apple Inc. ( AAPL ) and Facebook Inc. ( FB ) , Belfort said.
"That's why Amazon is awesome...And I love Apple, too, but I can't get in touch with Apple and Facebook. There's no one to speak to."
